name: a11y-vue-fix-and-test
description: Applies each fix plan task in a Vue 3 codebase one task at a time: writes a failing vitest-axe plus `@testing-library/vue` test first, makes the smallest single-file-component change (native elements, `useId`, `nextTick` focus, persistent live regions, Vue Router title and focus hooks), enables eslint-plugin-vuejs-accessibility, and commits only when test, lint and suite pass.
